facebook.caption:
4.9 stars. 3,034 reviews. At a beachfront restaurant in Phu Quoc.

Mai Hương Beachfront sits right on the Grand World strip and somehow still pulls those numbers. Not a fluke. Locals and tourists both rate it near-perfect, which almost never happens.

Grand World is loud and busy. This spot cuts through. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Waves behind you. Food in front. 3,034 people gave Mai Hương Beachfront 4.9 stars and after this footage you'll see why. Grand World Phu Quoc just hit different here.
